messages.subject: For Mohammed Alardhi | Private capital, strategic partnerships and emerging-market stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Investcorp Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Mohammed Alardhi, Executive Chairman.

Investcorp's global private-capital platform operates across strategic sectors and markets where government relationships, institutional partnerships and operating execution directly influence long-term value. That intersection aligns closely with my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution in a complex emerging-market environment.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and operating-side stakeholder strategy might support Investcorp's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Investcorp.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
